oauth2_client_id.description: Your oauth2 client id can be found in the [Customer Control Panel](https://new.contabo.com/account/security) under the menu item account secret.

oauth2_client_secret.description: Your oauth2 client secret can be found in the [Customer Control Panel](https://new.contabo.com/account/security) under the menu item account secret.

oauth2_pass.description: API Password (this is a new password which you'll set or change in the [Customer Control Panel](https://new.contabo.com/account/security) under the menu item account secret.)

oauth2_user.description: API User (your email address to login to the [Customer Control Panel](https://new.contabo.com/account/security) under the menu item account secret.

creation_date.description: The creation date of the image.

error_message.description: If the image is in an error state (see status property), the error message can be seen in this field.

id.description: The identifier of the image. Use it to manage it!

image_url.description: URL from which the image has been downloaded.

last_updated.description: Time of the last update of the image.

os_type.description: Provided type of operating system (OS). Please specify Windows for MS `Windows` and `Linux` for other OS. Specifying wrong OS type may lead to disfunctional cloud instance.

standard_image.description: Flag indicating that the image is either a standard (true) or a custom image (false).

status.description: Downloading status of the image (`downloading`, `downloaded` or `error`).

uploaded_size_mb.description: The size of the uploaded image in megabyte.

version.description: Version number to distinguish the contents of an image e.g. the version of the operating system.

block.description: In order to provide a custom image, please specify an URL from which the image can be downloaded directly. A custom image must be in either `.iso` or `.qcow2` format. Other formats will be rejected. Please note that downloading can take a while depending on network speed resp. bandwidth and size of image. You can check the status by retrieving information about the image via a GET request. Download will be rejected if you have exceeded your limits.

additional_ips.description: All other additional IP addresses of the instance.

cancel_date.description: The date on which the instance will be cancelled.

cpu_cores.description: CPU core count of the instance.

created_date.description: The creation date of the compute instance.

disk_mb.description: Image disk size of the instance in megabyte.

display_name.description: The instance name chosen by the customer that will be shown in the customer panel.

error_message.description: If the instance is in an error state (see status property), the error message can be seen in this field.

existing_instance_id.description: The identifier of the existing compute instance. (override id)

existing_instance_image_default.description: The name of an existing image to rollback on when destroying an existing instance (existing_instance_id). Defaulting to ubuntu.

id.description: The identifier of the compute instance. Use it to manage it!

image_id.description: CAUTION: On updating this value your server will be reinstalled! Image Id is used to set up the compute instance. Ubuntu 20.04 is the default, currently you have to get the Id with our [API](https://api.contabo.com/#tag/Images/operation/retrieveImage) or via our [command line](https://github.com/contabo/cntb) tool with this command: `cntb get images`.

last_updated.description: Time of the last update of the compute instance.

license.description: Additional license in order to enhance your chosen product. It is mainly needed for software licenses on your product (not needed for windows). See our [api documentation](https://api.contabo.com/#tag/Instances/operation/createInstance) for all available licenses.

os_type.description: Type of operating system (OS) installed on the instance.

period.description: Initial contract period in months. Available periods are: 1, 3, 6 and 12 months. The default setting is 1 month.

product_id.description: Choose the VPS/VDS product you want to buy. See our products [here](https://api.contabo.com/#tag/Instances/operation/createInstance).

product_type.description: InsInstance's category depending on Product Id. Following product types are available: `hdd`,`ssd`,`vds`,`nvme`.

region.description: Instance Region where the compute instance should be located. Default region is the EU. Following regions are available: `EU`,`US-central`,`US-east`,`US-west`,`SIN`.

root_password.description: CAUTION: On updating this value your server will be reinstalled! Root password of the compute instance.

ssh_keys.description: CAUTION: On updating this value your server will be reinstalled! Array of `secretIds` of public SSH keys for logging into as defaultUser with administrator/root privileges. Applies to Linux/BSD systems. Please refer to Secrets Management API.

status.description: Status of the compute instance. The status can be set to `provisioning`, `uninstalled`, `running`, `stopped`, `error`, `installing`, `unknown`, or `installed`.

user_data.description: CAUTION: On updating this value your server will be reinstalled! Cloud-Init Config in order to customize during start of compute instance.

id.description: Id of the Addon. Please refer to list [here](https://contabo.com/en/product-list/?show_ids=true).

quantity.description: The number of Addons you wish to aquire.

block.description: The Compute Management API allows you to manage compute resources (e.g. creation, deletion, starting, stopping) as well as managing snapshots and custom images. It also supports [cloud-init](https://cloud-init.io/) at least on our default images (for custom images you will need to provide cloud-init support packages). The API offers providing cloud-init scripts via the user_data field. Custom images must be provided in .qcow2 or .iso format.

auto_delete_date.description: The date when the snapshot will be autmatically deleted.

created_date.description: The creation date of this instance snapshot.

id.description: The identifier of the instance snapshot. Use it to manage it!

image_id.description: Id of the Image the snapshot was taken from.

image_name.description: Name of the Image the snapshot was taken from.

instance_id.description: Instance identifier associated with the snapshot.

cancel_date.description: The date on which the Object Storage will be cancelled and therefore no longer available.

created_date.description: The creation date of the Object Storage.

data_center.description: Data center the object storage is located in.

id.description: The identifier of the Object Storage. Use it to manage it!

region.description: Region where the Object Storage should be located. Default region is the EU. Following regions are available: `EU`,`US-central`, `SIN`.

s3_tenant_id.description: Your S3 tenant Id. Only required for public sharing.

s3_url.description: S3 URL to connect to your S3 compatible Object Storage.

status.description: The object storage status. It can be set to `PROVISIONING`,`READY`,`UPGRADING`,`CANCELLED`,`ERROR` or `DISABLED`.

total_purchased_space_tb.description: Amount of purchased / requested object storage in terabyte.

error_message.description: If the autoscaling is in an error state (see status property), the error message can be seen in this field.

size_limit_tb.description: Autoscaling size limit for the current object storage.

state.description: Status of this object storage.  It can be set to `enabled`, `disabled` or `error`.

block.description: Manage S3 compatible Object Storage. With the Object Storage API you can create Object Storages in different locations. Please note that you can only have one Object Storage per location. Furthermore, you can increase the amount of storage space and control the autoscaling feature which allows you to automatically perform a monthly upgrade of the disk space to the specified maximum. You might also inspect the usage. This API is not the S3 API itself. For accessing the S3 API directly or with S3 compatible tools like `aws` cli and after having created / upgraded your Object Storage please use the S3 URL from this Storage API and refer to the User Mangement API to retrieve the S3 credentials.

creation_date.description: The creation date of the bucket.

id.description: The identifier of the Object Storage. Use it to manage it!

name.description: The name of your bucket, consider the naming restriction https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-s3-bucket-naming-requirements.html.

object_storage_id.description: The contabo objectStorageId on which the bucket should be created.

public_sharing.description: Choose the access to your bucket. You can not share it at all or share it publicly.

public_sharing_link.description: If your bucket is publicly shared, you can access it with this link.

block.description: Manage buckets on your contabo Object Storage. With this resource you are able to manage your buckets the same way your are able to manage them in your contabo customer panel.

cidr.description: The cidr range of the Private Network.

created_date.description: The creation date of the Private Network.

data_center.description: The specific data center where the Private Network is located.

description.description: The description of the Private Network. There is a limit of 255 characters per Private Network.

id.description: The identifier of the Private Network. Use it to manage it!

instance_ids.description: Add the instace Ids to the private network here. If you do not add any instance Ids an empty private network will be created.

name.description: The name of the Private Network. It may contain letters, numbers, colons, dashes, and underscores. There is a limit of 255 characters per Private Network name.

region.description: The region where the Private Network should be located. Default region is the EU.

region_name.description: The name of the region where the Private Network is located.

updated_at.description: Time of the last update of the private network.

block.description: Provides a Contabo [Private Network](https://api.contabo.com/#tag/Private-Networks) resource.  Private Networks can contain your compute instances whereby they are able to communicate with each other in full usolation, using private IP addresses.

created_at.description: The creation date of the secret.

id.description: The identifier of the secret. Use it to manage it!

type.description: The type of the secret. It will be available only when retrieving secrets, following types are allowed: `ssh`, `password`.

updated_at.description: Last updated time of the secret.

value.description: The value of the secret. It will be available only when retrieving a single secret.

block.description: The Secret Management API allows you to store and manage your passwords and ssh-keys. Usage of the Secret Management API is purely optional. As a convenience feature e.g. it allows you to reuse SSH-keys easily.

id.description: The identifier of the tag. Use it to manage it!

block.description: Tags are Customer-defined labels which can be attached to any resource in your account. Tag API represent simple CRUD functions and allow you to manage your tags. Use tags to group your resources. For example you can define some user group with tag and give them permission to create compute instances.

id.description: The identifier of the tag assignment. Use it to manage it!

block.description: Tag assignment marks the specified resource with the specified tag for organizing purposes or to restrict access to that resource.
